title: A Stack Built From a Queue

concept.title: Rotate the queue after every push
body: A queue gives the oldest item first, but a **stack** must give the newest item first. A single queue can behave like a stack if the newest item is always kept at the **front**. After each `push` the new item is at the back, so **rotate** the queue: take the front item and put it at the back, as many times as there were older items. Then the new item is in front.

body.code:
push x:   queue.append(x)
          for _ in range(len(queue) - 1):
              queue.append(queue.popleft())     # now x is at the front
pop:      queue.popleft()
top:      queue[0]
empty:    len(queue) == 0

body: `pop`, `top` and `empty` are O(1), and `push` costs O(size). (There are other designs where pop is the slow operation; the total work is similar.)

statement: Process `n` operations on an initially empty stack, using only queue operations in your solution. `push x` puts `x` on top. `pop` removes and prints the top. `top` prints the top without removing it. `empty` prints `yes` if the stack is empty and `no` otherwise. Every line has an operation and a number; for `pop`, `top` and `empty` the number is 0 and is ignored. `pop` and `top` are only used when the stack is not empty. Print one line for every `pop`, `top` and `empty`.
inputFormat: Each of the next `n` lines has an operation and a number.
outputFormat: One line for every `pop`, `top` and `empty` operation.
constraints: There is at least one `pop`, `top` or `empty` operation.

examples.note: The top is 2; pop gives 2; the stack still has 1: not empty.

hints: Keep the newest item at the front of the queue.
After adding an item at the back, move all older items behind it.
Then pop is the same as taking the front of the queue.

starter.python:
import sys
input = sys.stdin.readline

n = int(input())
ops = [input().split() for _ in range(n)]

# Your code here

explanation: After each push the older items are rotated behind the new one, so the front of the queue is always the top of the stack.
solution.complexity: push O(size), pop, top and empty O(1).
